data.narrative:
Recursion Pharmaceuticals is a public-stage biotech & health company with $2B+ raised and current market valuation of $1.6B. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 11 peers spanning biotech and health: 3 public tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies including Abridge ($5.3B, Series E), Chai Discovery ($3.8B, Series C), New Limit ($3.1B, Series C), Freenome ($1.1B, public), and Alto Neuroscience ($1.0B, public).

Peer-median valuation represents the primary applicable method, drawing from 6 same-sector peers at similar valuation tiers. The median across this set stands at $2.1B, with a range spanning $539M to $5.3B. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples (median 5.6x across the three public tickers) cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue data for the target.

The triangulated valuation range is $1.8B to $2.4B (median $2.1B), supported by a single quantifiable method. This implies the current market valuation of $1.6B trades at a 24% discount to the peer median. Key uncertainties include the comparability of peers across clinical-stage and commercial maturity, the predictive power of a single method, and material revenue or pipeline developments not reflected in valuation-date comps.
